limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by an agent that did not write or source-review the guide; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.
API sessions created prerequisites, played second actors' writes and read back saved state and refusals. Every guide step ran in the browser as the named role.

Other agents on this host create and remove lab networks. Chromium then aborted in-flight requests with net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED and the app showed Something went wrong.; the scripts reload up to twice and log each retry under retries in the logs. 36 direct reloads of the affected Signatures pages afterwards showed no error page, so this is recorded as environment noise, not a product bug.

Run on the shared work lab (openlaw-docs-9d2b1705-work) with other DOC-032 agents. Only records named DOC-032 contracts-2 were created; fixture Fields, Contract types, the Status and Approver groups were archived after the run. Pickers therefore also listed people and records other agents created.

Confirms the author's limitation: the Owners section has only the accessible name Owners and no visible heading. The walkthrough found it by that name, before the Contract card, holding Legal Owner and Business Owner; the card itself has neither.
The seeded Counterparty Litware Insurance Company used by the DOC-030 script is not in this seed; the walkthrough used Tailspin Logistics BV.
The failed upload after Create was induced with a routed 503 answer in the browser.

Product bug still present from DOC-030 (retype-dialog-ignores-branch, in walkthrough.json): re-typing demands a required Field Row under a Branch whose condition does not hold. The guide's re-type sentences stay true.
Not exercised: creating a Contract through an Auto-Doc Generation (source only, technical-review.json).

compatibilityReview.summary: From 4ca41822 to ad345da5 (bridge): I read the whole app diff. None. No hunk reaches a claim of this guide: the range changes only version strings, comments, tests, the unused message catalog, the build tool turbo, and nodemailer and sharp patch releases. The guide makes no claim about the app version, email content or delivery, or organization logo processing, and its recorded steps read no mail and save no logo. No statement changed.
